name: Digits
description: Turn your Digits financials into a live data feed for Claude. Get instant answers about transactions, balances, and financial statements, or configure Claude to automate recurring tasks — weekly cash summaries, burn rate alerts, board-ready reports.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Digits to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Digits to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.digits.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Digits MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Digits provides these MCP tools: list_businesses, select_business, list_business_users, and query_transactions.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Digits?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Digits in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Digits requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Digits is developed by Digits Financial, Inc.. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
